C5.2.note: Pareto dominance and ex post efficiency are evaluated on the profile R that is the argument of f. Held attitudes are not defined separately from it, and no statement links this evaluation to held attitudes.

C3.1.reason: Every theorem imposes strategyproofness, which explicitly considers voters voting dishonestly; this is consistent with both coders treating voters as STRAT in C6.

C3.2.reason: Since C3.1 = ALL, the codebook requires NA.

C4.1.reason: The paper defines utilities as consistent with the ranking, which is the codebook's own example of SPEC.

C5.2.reason: Efficiency is evaluated on the SDS's argument R, with no separately defined held attitude, so HELD does not apply and no relating statement is made.

C9.2.reason: The needed assumptions behind the listed claims (possible misreporting and the incentive to manipulate) are stated explicitly in the introduction and Section 2.1.
